brand #6366f1

Brand Shade Scale

12-step chromatic ramp at the brand hue — 1 near-white tint, 12 near-black shade. Each cell labels its functional intent below the token (surfaces 1–5 → borders 6–8 → text 9–12); hover still shows the full legend from the article's 50–950 guide. No hover required to read the intent.

The 12-Step Neutral Ramp

Chromatic grays — every step is tinted with the locked brand hue. Hover a cell for its semantic use.

Brand Accent

Lightness-normalized to clear WCAG AAA with its on-color.

Semantic Tokens

Functional intent → global token.

bg-surface

Surfaces — canvas, panels, hover/active, overlay, and status tints.

border

Boundaries — subtle rules, strong focus, and status borders.

text

Typography — primary/muted/disabled and status text.

text-on

On-colors — labels on accent and status solids.

bg-action

Actions — brand execution.

Status Families

Four fixed canonical hues, independent of the brand coordinate.

Status Shade Scales

One 12-step ramp per canonical hue; steps share the neutral lightness ladder but peak chroma mid-scale. Dark theme scales back ~10% (article Step 6). Each cell labels its functional intent — no hover required.
